title: Innovative Organic Farming Practices Boost Income
reason: Describes an organic farming method and its economic and environmental benefits.

tasks.task: Outline San Timatunog's journey towards sustainable organic farming.

subtasks.text: Introduce San Timatunog as a 62-year-old rice farmer and his motivation to improve farming methods.
Describe the initial challenge of using the land for treasure hunting and the continuous need for learning.
Highlight the adoption of container gardening and its purpose as a climate change adaptation method.

tasks.task: Detail the various innovations and practices employed in the organic farm.

subtasks.text: Explain the local innovations of tea-based organic fertilizer and natural pesticides.
Describe the modification of multi-storey crapping and the integration of Korean pig racing.
Mention the establishment of native tilapia ponds and the use of snail feed.
Showcase the use of pand water during dry seasons and the planting of windbreaks.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the economic success and the transfer of his farming system to others.

subtasks.text: Present San Timatunog's increased income from organic farming.
Emphasize the importance of continuous learning and experience in effective agricultural practices.
